entry.title: Maid Lash: N°7, Grand Service 1.0.0
entry.content:
1.0.0 (2026-11-22, build b42, Deadlock build 6864)
First release.
- The outfit on Lash's own body: a parlourmaid's livery cut like a sailor uniform, a hooped skirt, a looped-up train, lace, bows and laced boots, with cloth on the skirt, train and ribbons. - Every ability re-dressed (ribbons, doilies, porcelain, rose petals, a cloche), new HUD cards and ability icons, 86 re-keyed animation clips, and a sound set built from physical models. His voice is untouched. - A hero-page scene with its own pose and lighting, installed by script from your own game files. - Cosmetic only: hitboxes, silhouette limits and gameplay cues checked against Valve's Lash.
